name: Symbols and SLD
description: Symbol library and SLD in one run. Checks the Revit family-template folder first and stops there with the fix when it is unset, builds every symbol catalogue (reporting catalogues that produced nothing and fills drawn as outlines), then generates the single line diagram. Chains the preconditions so an unset template folder can no longer produce 0 families followed by an empty SLD.

steps.label: Check the Revit family-template folder
steps._notes: Returns Failed when the template folder or the Generic Annotation .rft cannot be found, so rollback_on_failure stops the workflow before a build that would make 0 families.

steps.label: Load shared parameters
steps._notes: Binds the STING shared parameters so the built symbols can take their shared definitions. Optional: a missing shared-parameter file must not stop the build.

steps.label: Build all symbol catalogues
steps._notes: Runs the same template check itself; its report lists any catalogue that produced 0 families and any filled region drawn as an outline.

steps.label: Generate the single line diagram
steps._notes: Optional: a project with no electrical circuits has nothing to draw. SLD families resolve through ContentRoots, where Symbols_CreateAll writes them.

_postNotes: Re-runnable. Symbols_CreateAll counts families that already exist as Existed.
If the check fails, set Options > File Locations > Family Template Files and re-run.
